ACTC1.source: Hypertrophic/dilated cardiomyopathy: missense variants in the actin sarcomere are the established mechanism; curated snapshot, expert reconfirmation recommended.

APC.source: Familial adenomatous polyposis: truncating loss-of-function variants are the predominant established mechanism; curated snapshot, expert reconfirmation recommended.

APOB.source: Familial hypercholesterolaemia (familial defective apoB-100): missense variants in the LDL-receptor-binding domain (e.g. p.Arg3527Gln) are the established mechanism; curated snapshot, expert reconfirmation recommended.

BRCA1.source: ClinGen ENIGMA expert panel: most established pathogenic BRCA1 variants are truncating loss-of-function; PP2/BP1 usage follows ENIGMA specifications.

BRCA2.source: ClinGen ENIGMA expert panel: most established pathogenic BRCA2 variants are truncating loss-of-function; PP2/BP1 usage follows ENIGMA specifications.

CACNA1S.source: Malignant hyperthermia susceptibility: missense variants are the established disease mechanism; curated snapshot, expert reconfirmation recommended.

CFTR.source: Cystic fibrosis: missense/in-frame variants (paradigmatically p.Phe508del) causing protein misfolding are the single most common pathogenic mechanism; curated snapshot, expert reconfirmation recommended.

CHEK2.source: Moderate-penetrance breast cancer risk: truncating loss-of-function founder variants (e.g. c.1100delC) are the predominant established mechanism; curated snapshot, expert reconfirmation recommended.

COL1A1.source: Osteogenesis imperfecta: glycine substitutions in the Gly-X-Y triple-helical repeat are the established pathogenic mechanism; curated snapshot, expert reconfirmation recommended.

COL1A2.source: Osteogenesis imperfecta: glycine substitutions in the Gly-X-Y triple-helical repeat are the established pathogenic mechanism; curated snapshot, expert reconfirmation recommended.

COL2A1.source: Type II collagenopathies (achondrogenesis, spondyloepiphyseal dysplasia): triple-helix glycine substitutions are the established pathogenic mechanism; curated snapshot, expert reconfirmation recommended.

COL4A5.source: Alport syndrome: glycine substitutions in the collagen IV triple-helical domain are a well-established pathogenic mechanism; curated snapshot, expert reconfirmation recommended.

DSP.source: Arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy / cardiocutaneous syndromes: truncating loss-of-function variants are the predominant established mechanism; curated snapshot, expert reconfirmation recommended.

FBN1.source: Marfan syndrome: cysteine substitutions disrupting cbEGF-domain calcium binding are the established pathogenic mechanism; curated snapshot, expert reconfirmation recommended.

FGFR2.source: Craniosynostosis syndromes (Crouzon, Apert): gain-of-function missense variants are the established mechanism; curated snapshot, expert reconfirmation recommended.

FGFR3.source: Achondroplasia / thanatophoric dysplasia / hypochondroplasia: gain-of-function missense variants at well-defined hotspot codons are the established mechanism; curated snapshot, expert reconfirmation recommended.

HRAS.source: Costello syndrome: gain-of-function missense variants at well-defined hotspot codons are the established mechanism; curated snapshot, expert reconfirmation recommended.

KCNH2.source: Long QT syndrome type 2: missense variants, frequently causing channel trafficking defects, are a well-established mechanism; curated snapshot, expert reconfirmation recommended.

KCNJ2.source: Andersen-Tawil syndrome: missense variants with dominant-negative effects on Kir2.1 channel function are the established mechanism; curated snapshot, expert reconfirmation recommended.

KCNQ1.source: Long QT syndrome type 1: missense variants with dominant-negative effects on channel tetramerisation are the established mechanism; curated snapshot, expert reconfirmation recommended.

KCNQ2.source: Self-limited familial neonatal epilepsy / KCNQ2-related developmental and epileptic encephalopathy: missense variants with dominant-negative or gain-of-function effects are the established mechanism; curated snapshot, expert reconfirmation recommended.

KRAS.source: RASopathy (Noonan syndrome spectrum): gain-of-function missense variants at well-defined hotspot codons are the established mechanism; curated snapshot, expert reconfirmation recommended.

LDLR.source: Familial hypercholesterolaemia: missense variants disrupting LDL-receptor ligand binding/recycling are the predominant established mechanism; curated snapshot, expert reconfirmation recommended.

MEN1.source: Multiple endocrine neoplasia type 1: truncating loss-of-function variants are the predominant established tumour-suppressor mechanism; curated snapshot, expert reconfirmation recommended.

MUTYH.source: MUTYH-associated polyposis: the two most common founder pathogenic alleles are missense substitutions, not truncating variants; curated snapshot, expert reconfirmation recommended.

MYBPC3.source: Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy: haploinsufficiency from truncating variants is the predominant established mechanism; curated snapshot, expert reconfirmation recommended.

MYH7.source: Hypertrophic/dilated cardiomyopathy: missense variants in the motor/head domain acting via dominant-negative sarcomere disruption are the established mechanism; curated snapshot, expert reconfirmation recommended.

NF1.source: Neurofibromatosis type 1: truncating loss-of-function variants across this large tumour-suppressor gene are the predominant established mechanism; curated snapshot, expert reconfirmation recommended.

NF2.source: Neurofibromatosis type 2: truncating loss-of-function variants are the predominant established tumour-suppressor mechanism; curated snapshot, expert reconfirmation recommended.

PALB2.source: Hereditary breast/pancreatic cancer: truncating loss-of-function variants are the predominant established mechanism; missense variants are usually classified VUS. Curated snapshot, expert reconfirmation recommended.

PCSK9.source: Familial hypercholesterolaemia is caused by gain-of-function missense variants specifically (in contrast to loss-of-function PCSK9 variants, which are protective/hypocholesterolaemic); curated snapshot, expert reconfirmation recommended.

PKP2.source: Arrhythmogenic right ventricular cardiomyopathy: haploinsufficiency from truncating variants is the predominant established mechanism; curated snapshot, expert reconfirmation recommended.

PTEN.source: PTEN hamartoma tumour syndrome: missense variants disrupting the phosphatase catalytic domain are a well-established mechanism alongside truncating variants; curated snapshot, expert reconfirmation recommended.

PTPN11.source: Noonan syndrome: gain-of-function missense variants in the catalytic/N-SH2 interacting domains are the established mechanism; curated snapshot, expert reconfirmation recommended.

RAF1.source: Noonan syndrome: gain-of-function missense variants are the established RASopathy mechanism for this gene; curated snapshot, expert reconfirmation recommended.

RB1.source: Retinoblastoma: truncating loss-of-function variants are the predominant established tumour-suppressor mechanism; curated snapshot, expert reconfirmation recommended.

RET.source: Multiple endocrine neoplasia type 2: gain-of-function missense variants at well-defined cysteine-rich and tyrosine-kinase-domain hotspot codons are the established mechanism; curated snapshot, expert reconfirmation recommended.

RYR1.source: Malignant hyperthermia susceptibility / central core disease: missense variants clustering in defined hotspot regions are the established mechanism; curated snapshot, expert reconfirmation recommended.

SCN5A.source: Missense variants are a recognised mechanism for both Brugada syndrome (loss-of-function) and long QT syndrome type 3 (gain-of-function); phenotype-dependent, mechanistically heterogeneous. Curated snapshot, expert reconfirmation recommended.

SDHB.source: Hereditary paraganglioma-pheochromocytoma syndrome: truncating loss-of-function variants are the predominant established tumour-suppressor mechanism; curated snapshot, expert reconfirmation recommended.

SMAD4.source: Juvenile polyposis syndrome: truncating loss-of-function variants are the predominant established mechanism; curated snapshot, expert reconfirmation recommended.

SOS1.source: Noonan syndrome: gain-of-function missense variants are the established RASopathy mechanism for this gene; curated snapshot, expert reconfirmation recommended.

STK11.source: Peutz-Jeghers syndrome: truncating loss-of-function variants are the predominant established mechanism; curated snapshot, expert reconfirmation recommended.

TGFBR1.source: Loeys-Dietz syndrome: kinase-domain missense variants are the established dominant-negative mechanism; curated snapshot, expert reconfirmation recommended.

TGFBR2.source: Loeys-Dietz syndrome: kinase-domain missense variants are the established dominant-negative mechanism; curated snapshot, expert reconfirmation recommended.

TNNI3.source: Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy: missense variants are the predominant reported disease mechanism; curated snapshot, expert reconfirmation recommended.

TNNT2.source: Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy: missense variants altering troponin T-tropomyosin interaction are an established dominant-negative mechanism; curated snapshot, expert reconfirmation recommended.

TP53.source: Li-Fraumeni syndrome: the majority of established germline pathogenic variants are missense substitutions clustering in the DNA-binding domain, acting via dominant-negative/loss-of-function effects; curated snapshot, expert reconfirmation recommended.

TSC1.source: Tuberous sclerosis complex: truncating loss-of-function variants are the predominant established mechanism for this gene; curated snapshot, expert reconfirmation recommended.

TTN.source: Dilated cardiomyopathy: haploinsufficiency from truncating variants (especially A-band, high-PSI exons) is the established mechanism; missense variants are common in the general population and are usually benign background variation. Curated snapshot, expert reconfirmation recommended.
